title: 第17章 我有一计应该是他们主动把人送来第18章 疑似大雷控的系统
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 六祖的话，如同平地惊雷，在混沌大殿中炸响。
江战在一旁听得眼皮直跳。
绑……绑过来？
六祖爷爷，您老人家也太直接了吧！
虽然……这想法确实挺诱人的。
“老六，注意你的言辞！”
初祖瞪了六祖一眼，随即转向江渊，脸上露出了无比和蔼的笑容，“渊儿啊，别听你六祖爷爷瞎说，我们江家是名门帝族，怎么能干那种强抢民女的事情呢？”
江渊松了口气，心想还是初祖靠谱。
“我们都是直接上门提亲的。”
初祖慢悠悠地补充了一句，“带上我们江家的诚意，和几件帝兵，心平气和地跟他们谈，
如果他们不讲道理，我们就再讲讲道理，如果他们还不听，那我们再跟他们讲讲物理。”
好家伙，一个比一个狠。
他算是看明白了，在这帮老祖宗眼里，只要能让他多生孩子，别说提亲了，就是发动一场不朽帝战，他们都眼都不带眨一下的。
“渊儿，你觉醒的这个圣体，对我江家而言，意义太过重大了。”
初祖的声音变得无比郑重，他站起身，那看似模糊的身影，在这一刻却仿佛撑起了整片混沌。
“它不仅仅是让你个人变强的途径，更是关乎我江家未来万世气运的根基！”
“我们这些老家伙都卡在大帝境太久太久了，前路已断，只能在这祖地苟延残喘，等待寿元耗尽的那一天。”
“我们曾以为，江家的辉煌或许就要在我们这一代之后，慢慢走向沉寂，可你的出现，让我们看到了新的希望！”
初祖的目光扫过其他几位老祖，他们的意志化身，此刻也都变得无比凝重。
“圣灵丹，能造就圣体，这意味着我江家将能源源不断地诞生巅峰战力！”
初祖的目光最终落在江渊身上，充满了无尽的期许，“你，才是这一切的核心！只要你能不断诞下后代，获得天道回馈，我江家就有可能打破万古禁锢，诞生出真正的仙！”
“到那时，我江家将不再是区区一个帝族，而是真正的仙族！永恒不朽，与世长存！”
“所以，渊儿……”
初祖对着江渊，这位江家辈分最高，实力最深不可测的古老存在，竟然微微躬身，行了一礼。
“从今往后，你的事，就是我江家最高的事！你的安危，就是我江家最重要的事！你的……需求，就是我江家必须满足的事！”
“你，就是我江家万古以来，唯一的希望！”
轰！
初祖的话，让江渊的脑袋嗡的一声。
他被吓到了。
被一位大帝老祖行礼，这压力也太大了！
“初祖爷爷，您这是干什么！快起来！折煞我了！”江渊连忙上前去扶。
“不，这一礼，你受得起。”
初祖摇了摇头，神情肃穆，“这是我们这些老家伙，对江家未来的托付！”
其他几位老祖，也纷纷对着江渊，微微躬身。
content_en:
The words of the Sixth Patriarch were like thunder on the ground, exploding in the Chaos Hall.
Jiang Zhan's eyelids jumped as he heard this.
Tied...tied over?
Grandpa Sixth Patriarch, you are too direct!
Although... this idea is indeed quite tempting.
"Lao Liu, watch your words!"
The First Ancestor glared at the Sixth Ancestor, then turned to Jiang Yuan, with an extremely kind smile on his face, "Yuan'er, don't listen to your Sixth Ancestor's nonsense. Our Jiang family is a famous imperial family, how can we do that kind of thing like robbing civilian girls?"
Jiang Yuan breathed a sigh of relief, thinking that the first ancestor was still reliable.
"We all come directly to propose marriage."
The first ancestor added slowly, "Bring the sincerity of our Jiang family and a few imperial weapons, and talk to them calmly,
If they don't listen, we'll talk to them about physics. If they still don't listen, we'll talk to them about physics. "
Jiang Yuan: "..."
Good guys, one is more ruthless than the other.
He finally understood that in the eyes of these ancestors, as long as he could have more children, let alone propose marriage, they would launch an immortal imperial war without blinking an eye.
"Yuan'er, the holy body you awakened is of great significance to our Jiang family."
The First Ancestor's voice became extremely solemn, and he stood up. The seemingly blurry figure seemed to hold up the entire chaos at this moment.
"It is not only a way for you to become stronger personally, but it is also related to the foundation of my Jiang family's destiny for all generations in the future!"
"We old guys have been stuck in the Great Emperor Realm for too long. The way forward has been cut off. We can only linger in this ancestral land and wait for the day when our life span is exhausted."
"We once thought that the glory of the Jiang family might slowly fade into silence after our generation, but your appearance gave us new hope!"
The first ancestor's gaze swept across the other ancestors, and their will incarnations became extremely solemn at this moment.
"The Holy Spirit Pill can create a holy body, which means that our Jiang family will continuously produce peak combat power!"
"And you..."
The first ancestor's eyes finally fell on Jiang Yuan, full of endless expectations, "You are the core of all this! As long as you can continue to give birth to offspring and receive feedback from heaven, my Jiang family may be able to break the eternal imprisonment and give birth to a true immortal!"
"At that time, our Jiang family will no longer be just an imperial clan, but a real immortal clan! Eternal and immortal, we will live forever!"
"So, Yuan'er..."
The first ancestor bowed slightly to Jiang Yuan, the ancient being with the highest seniority and the most unfathomable strength in the Jiang family.
"From now on, your business is the most important thing of my Jiang family! Your safety is the most important thing of my Jiang family! Your... needs are what my Jiang family must satisfy!"
"You are my Jiang family's only hope for all eternity!"
Boom!
The first ancestor's words made Jiang Yuan's head buzz.
He was frightened.
Being saluted by an ancestor of the Great Emperor is too much pressure!
"Grandpa Chuzu, what are you doing! Get up! You're hurting me!" Jiang Yuan quickly stepped forward to help him.
"No, you can bear this gift."
The first ancestor shook his head, with a solemn expression, "This is the entrustment that we old guys have for the future of the Jiang family!"
Several other ancestors also bowed slightly towards Jiang Yuan.
